svg.title: Ligand-bound Single-pass Receptor
svg.desc: Original generic single-pass receptor with an extracellular binding region, one continuous membrane-spanning segment and a cytoplasmic tail. A separate symbolic ligand contacts the extracellular region. No named receptor structure, activity or scale is implied.
